**Synopsis:**
Energy markets are under pressure from escalating Gulf shipping attacks tied to the Iran war, pushing crude oil above $100/bbl and 10-year Treasury yields toward 5%. A disappointing $6B Treasury bond buyback failed to relieve bond market stress. The ECB is set to hike rates 25bps to 2.5%, with further hikes priced in. Trump signaled no war resolution before midterms, threatening prolonged energy price elevation. Proposed $1T+ stimulus checks add fiscal pressure. AI regulation risks and PPI data are also in focus.
